tasks.label: inspect-github-auth
tasks.command: echo 'USER='"$USER"; echo 'HOME='"$HOME"; env | grep -Ei '^(GITHUB|GH|GIT)_|TOKEN|USERNAME' | sed 's/=.*$/=***hidden***/' || true; git config --global --list | sed -n '1,80p' || true; git config --local --list | sed -n '1,80p' || true

tasks.label: check-github-access
tasks.command: echo '--- SSH keys ---' && ls -la ~/.ssh 2>/dev/null || true && echo '--- SSH test ---' && ssh -T -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no git@github.com 2>&1 | sed -n '1,20p' || true

tasks.label: inspect-git-credentials
tasks.command: echo '--- global config ---' && git config --global --list --show-origin || true && echo '--- credential helper ---' && git config --global --get credential.helper || true && echo '--- git credentials file ---' && if [ -f ~/.git-credentials ]; then echo exists; sed -n '1p' ~/.git-credentials | sed 's/:[^:@]*@/:***@/'; else echo 'not found'; fi && echo '--- netrc ---' && if [ -f ~/.netrc ]; then echo exists; sed -n '1,5p' ~/.netrc | sed -E 's/(password).*/\1=***hidden***/; else echo 'not found'; fi

tasks.label: probe-github-env
check-git-remote-setup
tasks.command:
set -e
cd /home/zhou_c_WMGDS.WMG.WARWICK.AC.UK/data_prepare
printf '--- repo status ---\n'
git init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
git status --short --branch
printf '\n--- remotes ---\n'
git remote -v || true
printf '\n--- user identity ---\n'
git config user.name || true
git config user.email || true
printf '\n--- github auth check ---\n'
if [ -f ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml ]; then echo 'gh hosts config exists'; fi
if [ -f ~/.git-credentials ]; then echo 'git-credentials exists'; fi
if [ -f ~/.netrc ]; then echo 'netrc exists'; fi

tasks.label: inspect-github-credentials-2
tasks.command:
set -e
cd /home/zhou_c_WMGDS.WMG.WARWICK.AC.UK/data_prepare
printf '%s
' '--- python ---'
command -v python3 || true
printf '%s
' '--- gh ---'
command -v gh || true
printf '%s
' '--- env vars ---'
env | grep -E '^(GITHUB|GH|GIT|TOKEN|USERNAME|USER|PASSWORD)=' | sed 's/=.*$/=***hidden***/' || true
printf '%s
' '--- git config ---'
git config --global --list --show-origin || true
printf '%s
' '--- cred files ---'
[ -f ~/.git-credentials ] && echo '.git-credentials exists' || echo '.git-credentials missing'
[ -f ~/.netrc ] && echo '.netrc exists' || echo '.netrc missing'
[ -f ~/.config/gh/hosts.yml ] && echo 'gh hosts exists' || echo 'gh hosts missing'

tasks.label: git-initialize-and-commit
tasks.command:
set -e
cd /home/zhou_c_WMGDS.WMG.WARWICK.AC.UK/data_prepare
git init
if ! git config user.name >/dev/null; then git config user.name 'zhou_c'; fi
if ! git config user.email >/dev/null; then git config user.email 'zhou_c@users.noreply.github.com'; fi
git add .
git commit -m 'Initial commit'
